strain: 129S6/SvEv backcrossed onto C57BL/6J (5-HT2AR KO and WT littermates)
psychedelic: (±)DOI, TCB-2, LSD (plus non-hallucinogenic comparators Ariadne, 2-Br-LSD, lisuride) — applied ex vivo to brain membranes only

age.evidence: Adult mice with a final weight of 30-40 g were housed five per cage on a 12 h light/dark cycle at 22°C and 60% humidity with food and water available ad libitum.

sex.evidence: The methods describe '5-HT2AR KO and WT mice' and 'Adult mice with a final weight of 30-40 g' but never state the sex of the animals.

handling.evidence: No handling protocol is described anywhere in the methods.

group_housing.evidence: Adult mice with a final weight of 30-40 g were housed five per cage on a 12 h light/dark cycle at 22°C and 60% humidity with food and water available ad libitum.

day_night_flipped.evidence: 'on a 12 h light/dark cycle at 22°C and 60% humidity' — the direction of the cycle (lights-on time) is not stated.

enrichment_housing.evidence: Home-cage enrichment is not addressed; only cage density, light cycle, temperature, humidity and ad libitum food/water are described.

judge_notes: All three candidates independently returned an empty `assays` array; this is correct. The paper is entirely an ex vivo/in vitro [35S]GTPγS antibody-capture scintillation proximity assay study on post-mortem human prefrontal cortex membranes and on brain cortex membranes from 5-HT2AR KO/WT mice. No behavioural test was performed on any rodent.

No psychedelic was administered to a living rodent: mice were killed by cervical dislocation and drugs (10 μM) were applied to membrane preparations in 96-well plates. Per the rubric, ex vivo/in vitro work is explicitly non-scorable.

Dropped gemma4's `dosing` entries: the 10 μM concentrations are in-vitro bath concentrations applied to membrane homogenates, not in vivo doses administered to animals. Per the rubric, `dosing` captures compounds administered to animals in behavioural experiments — none were. `dosing` set to an empty array.

Head-twitch response, prepulse inhibition and antidepressant-like paradigms are discussed only in the Discussion as citations to prior literature (e.g. Halberstadt & Geyer 2013; Cunningham et al. 2023) and were not performed in this study.
Species/strain/age/housing retained at study level because transgenic mice were used as tissue donors and husbandry is described, but these fields carry no scored assay.
Sex scored not_reported (overriding qwen/gemma4 confidence ambiguity): the paper states only 'Adult mice', and the 85%-male figure refers to the human post-mortem donors, not the mice.
